players.product: Ethernet switch chips: 12.8T / 25.6T flagship chips (up to 800G ports) for large-scale data centers and cloud, TsingMa.MX 2.4T and GoldenGate 1.2T series, plus switch-chip modules and Ethernet switches

quarterly_data.quarter: Centec Communications results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (04-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman Lyu Baoli (2025 annual and Q1 2026 results briefing): Q1 2026 revenue was RMB 24,842.32 ten-thousand, up 11.4% year on year; the 2025 profit pressure came mainly from heavy R&D spending; in 2026 the company will keep investing heavily in R&D while strengthening supply-chain management, and expects its richer product line-up and gradually recovering market demand to bring new growth momentum in the medium to long term. Full-year 2026 revenue and margin were not guided.

quarterly_data.quarter: Centec Communications results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (04-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman Lyu Baoli (results briefing): the 12.8T/25.6T products, after more than a year of downstream customers' product design, have entered market promotion and gradual application at customers; general manager Sun Jianyong said the company is planning its next-generation high-end product for large data centers and cloud. Lyu, management view on competition: the global core Ethernet switch-chip supply chain is highly concentrated, with a few players holding most of the market; besides the company, the commercial vendors are mainly Broadcom and Marvell in the US and Realtek in Taiwan, which it watches as its main peers.
